title: Israeli Forces Storm 20+ West Bank Towns and Raid UNRWA Facility in Qalandia
detail: Israeli soldiers intensified their offensive across the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem, raiding at least 20 towns and villages, demolishing homes, and arresting dozens of Palestinians — an escalation of the crackdown launched after the July 24 Tal village shootout. Soldiers fired tear gas and detained staff at a UNRWA-run vocational training centre in the Qalandia refugee camp, north of occupied East Jerusalem. Arab states condemned the escalating pattern of settler attacks on Palestinian property occurring in parallel with the military operation. Rights monitors noted the West Bank was on pace to exceed 2,000 settler-related attacks for 2026, up from roughly 190/month in the year's first four months.
